ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Communicating messages and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Engaging parents or and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Soil environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Improving soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. B — 100 °C

4. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

5. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.

6. B — newton (N)

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

9. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

10. C — Glucose and oxygen

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.

12. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

16. (4 marks)
